chain_words.nuance: repeated irritation that wears on patience
very intense anger, often hard to control
anger so strong it provokes an outburst

explanation: These words all express anger, moving from mild annoyance to an outburst of extreme rage.

usage_notes.difference: 'Annoyed' describes a minor, passing irritation; 'furious' describes anger at a very high intensity that is usually visible in behavior.
